name: Your system, after 2 PM
rules: Uses your screener: last night's setups (Momentum and Pullback), in the stock table's order.

Holds 2 positions at a time, and never spends more than 30% of the account on one buy. Buys only after 2:00 PM Central (3:00 PM New York), at the first check after that, using the same setups and option rules as Your system. Sells on the same signals: the trend check at about 10:00 New York time, then stops and targets every 30 minutes until the close.

Buys a call by your rules (15-30 days out, delta 0.50-0.80, open interest over 500, bid/ask spread under 12%), the one nearest 0.65 delta, on the first of the top 15 setups that has one within 30% of the account. If none does, it takes a cheaper call down to 0.15 delta (same days out, open interest and spread), the highest delta that fits, on the first setup that has one. If no call fits even that, it buys shares of the top setup.
Skips a setup that has dropped below its 50-day EMA by the time it buys.

Your overbought rule: it doesn't buy anything with RSI over 70 or CCI over 100 (checked on the live price when it buys), or while the market's breadth or the stock's sector's is over the 75 line (the share of its stocks with the 10 EMA over the 20, last night).
Sells a call at +50% (at the bid), at -50%, 5 days before expiry, or after a close below the 50-day EMA or 150-day average.
Sells shares if they drop 8% or after a close below the 50-day EMA or 150-day average.
The exits are my defaults, since your screener doesn't set any. Tell me yours and I'll switch.
fills: Paper trades, no real money. Shares fill at Yahoo's latest 1-minute price, 0.05% worse, and fractional shares are allowed. Calls fill at the ask to buy and the bid to sell, plus $0.65 per contract each way. Yahoo's option quotes can lag by up to 15 minutes. Dividends are ignored.
